segments.text: Hello guys welcome back to my youtube channel Safety Management Study
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到我的 YouTube 频道 Safety Management Study。

segments.text: Guys today's topic is Safety Officer interview questions for industrial radiography
segments.zh: 各位，今天的主题是工业射线检测方面的安全员面试问题。

segments.text: In this video we will learn what are the questions related to industrial radiography
segments.zh: 在这个视频中，我们将了解安全员可能会被问到的

segments.text: which can be asked by a safety officer
segments.zh: 与工业射线检测相关的问题有哪些。

segments.text: So let's start this informative video
segments.zh: 那么，我们开始这个干货满满的视频吧。

segments.text: If you find the video informative then like the video and subscribe to the channel
segments.zh: 如果你觉得视频有用，请给视频点赞并订阅频道。

segments.text: The first question is what is an industrial radiography test?
segments.zh: 第一个问题是：什么是工业射线检测？

segments.text: What is a radiography test?
segments.zh: 什么是射线检测？

segments.text: An industrial radiography test is a non-destructive test of pipes to ensure the quality and durability of a metal
segments.zh: 工业射线检测是对管道进行的无损检测，用来确保金属的质量和耐久性。

segments.text: We call a radiography test a non-destructive test
segments.zh: 我们把射线检测称为无损检测。

segments.text: These tests are used to ensure the quality and durability of a metal pipe
segments.zh: 这些检测用于确保金属管道的质量和耐久性。

segments.text: Is there any defect in a metal pipe from a radiography test such as cracks, porosity, pinch holes or not?
segments.zh: 通过射线检测可以查出金属管道是否存在缺陷，比如裂纹、气孔、针孔等。

segments.text: Without any pipe being cut or damaged a metal pipe can be taken from an RT camera
segments.zh: 无需切割或损坏管道，就可以用 RT 相机对金属管道进行拍摄。

segments.text: A RT camera or a Gamma camera or an X-ray camera can be used
segments.zh: 可以使用 RT 相机，也就是伽马射线机或 X 射线机。

segments.text: Generally after a pipe is old or welding a radiography test is done
segments.zh: 一般在管道老化后或焊接后进行射线检测。

segments.text: Next, what is unit of measuring radiation?
segments.zh: 下一个，测量辐射的单位是什么？

segments.text: We measure radiation in curie, microcevert or milli-rump
segments.zh: 我们用居里、微希沃特或毫雷姆来测量辐射。

segments.text: Next, what is a Geiger or a survey meter?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是盖革计数器或巡测仪？

segments.text: A Geiger or a survey meter is a device with which we measure radiation
segments.zh: 盖革计数器或巡测仪是我们用来测量辐射的设备，

segments.text: or you can call it a safe distance
segments.zh: 也可以用来确定安全距离。

segments.text: Next, what is a dosimeter?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是剂量计？

segments.text: A dosimeter is a device with which a radiographer who is taking in radiation
segments.zh: 剂量计是一种设备，用来测量射线检测人员所接受的辐射。

segments.text: Next, how much radiation or dose of radiation is safe for a radiographer in one year?
segments.zh: 下一个，射线检测人员一年接受多少辐射或辐射剂量是安全的？

segments.text: Can a radiographer safely bear the amount of radiation in one year?
segments.zh: 射线检测人员一年可以安全承受多少辐射量？

segments.text: Its answer is 20 milli-ceverts per year
segments.zh: 答案是每年 20 毫希沃特。

segments.text: Next, what are the hazards of RT?
segments.zh: 下一个，RT 有哪些危害？

segments.text: The link to all the questions is in the description box, you can check
segments.zh: 所有问题的链接都在描述框中，你可以查看。

segments.text: There are hazards for radiography tests
segments.zh: 射线检测存在以下危害：

segments.text: Exposure to radiation for a long period of time
segments.zh: 长时间暴露于辐射。

segments.text: If you are exposed to radiation for a long period of time
segments.zh: 如果你长时间暴露于辐射之下，

segments.text: then this is a hazard
segments.zh: 这就是一种危害。

segments.text: Long term exposure
segments.zh: 长期暴露。

segments.text: Loss of hair, cancer and high amount of radiation exposure
segments.zh: 脱发、癌症，以及大剂量的辐射暴露

segments.text: can cause skin burn and fatality
segments.zh: 会造成皮肤灼伤乃至死亡。

segments.text: Next, unauthorized entry
segments.zh: 下一个，未经授权进入。

segments.text: Uncertified radiographers
segments.zh: 未经认证的射线检测人员。

segments.text: Next, what are the safety precautions for RT?
segments.zh: 下一个，RT 有哪些安全防范措施？

segments.text: Before radiography test, as a safety officer, you have to ensure all these safety points
segments.zh: 在射线检测之前，作为安全员，你必须确保以下所有安全要点：

segments.text: Valid work permit, JSA or risk assessment
segments.zh: 有效的工作许可证、JSA 或风险评估；

segments.text: Valid license of the radioactive source
segments.zh: 放射源的有效许可证；

segments.text: Calibration certificate of survey and dosimeter
segments.zh: 巡测仪和剂量计的校准证书；

segments.text: Third party qualification certificate of radiographer
segments.zh: 射线检测人员的第三方资格证书；

segments.text: Third party certification, NRPB
segments.zh: 第三方认证，NRPB，

segments.text: means National Radiation Protection Board
segments.zh: 即国家辐射防护委员会，

segments.text: should be approved
segments.zh: 应经其批准；

segments.text: Medical or vision test report
segments.zh: 体检或视力检查报告；

segments.text: Decay chart
segments.zh: 衰变图；

segments.text: Transport vehicle certificate
segments.zh: 运输车辆证书。

segments.text: The vehicle from which RT equipment is being transported
segments.zh: 运输 RT 设备的车辆

segments.text: should be approved by the Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulations
segments.zh: 应获得联邦核监管局的批准。

segments.text: Adequate area proper barricade, warning sign and warning lights should be installed
segments.zh: 要设置足够区域的适当围挡、警示标志和警示灯。

segments.text: Next, what is decay chart?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是衰变图？

segments.text: Decay chart is a chart
segments.zh: 衰变图是一种图表，

segments.text: which shows the changes in the period of time in radioactivity
segments.zh: 显示放射性随时间推移的变化。

segments.text: Next, what is controlled area?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是控制区？

segments.text: Controlled area is such an area where radiographers can work
segments.zh: 控制区是射线检测人员可以作业的区域。

segments.text: Next, how much radiation is safe for a radiographer?
segments.zh: 下一个，射线检测人员接受多少辐射是安全的？

segments.text: 7.5 micro-sever per hour
segments.zh: 每小时 7.5 微希沃特，

segments.text: Safe limit for a radiographer
segments.zh: 是射线检测人员的安全限值。

segments.text: Next, what is the safe limit of radiation for?
segments.zh: 下一个，以下人群的辐射安全限值是多少？

segments.text: General public
segments.zh: 普通公众。

segments.text: For general public, for 8 hours, 2.5 micro-sever per hour is safe
segments.zh: 对普通公众来说，8 小时内每小时 2.5 微希沃特是安全的。

segments.text: Next, what is film badge?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是胶片剂量计（胶片徽章）？

segments.text: Film badge is a device which measures the time of radiographer RT
segments.zh: 胶片剂量计是一种测量射线检测人员 RT 作业时间的设备，

segments.text: How many dose of radiation is being exposed in a month is measured
segments.zh: 用来测量一个月内受到的辐射剂量是多少。

segments.text: Next, what is isotope?
segments.zh: 下一个，什么是同位素？

segments.text: Isotopes are atoms whose atomic numbers are the same
segments.zh: 同位素是原子序数相同

segments.text: but mass numbers are different
segments.zh: 但质量数不同的原子。

segments.text: Isotopes can be stable or unstable
segments.zh: 同位素可以是稳定的，也可以是不稳定的。

segments.text: Isotopes are hazardous
segments.zh: 同位素是有危害的，

segments.text: because uncontrolled energy is released in the form of radiation wave
segments.zh: 因为会以辐射波的形式释放不受控制的能量，

segments.text: which damages living tissues and causes cancer
segments.zh: 从而损害活体组织并导致癌症。

segments.text: All questions are linked in the description box
segments.zh: 所有问题都链接在描述框中，

segments.text: You can also read the question answer
segments.zh: 你也可以阅读问题的答案。

segments.text: Thanks for watching
segments.zh: 感谢观看。

segments.text: Be safe, be happy
segments.zh: 注意安全，开开心心。
